Settings.title: Izilungiselelo
Settings.languageHint: Isebenzisa ulimi lweselula yakho kuze ukhethe lapha.

Login.visualText: Landela imali engenayo, izindleko nezinjongo zokonga endaweni eyodwa ezolileyo, enhle.
Login.signupTitle: Yenza i-akhawunti yakho — $1 ivula konke, kuze kube naphakade
Login.signinTitle: Siyakwamukela futhi! Ngena ukuze uqhubekele ku-akhawunti yakho

Landing.demoToast: Wamukelekile kwidemo — hlola nganoma, akukho lutho olugciniwe.

hero.lead: I-WellSpend Budget Tracker isiceli sebhajethi esizolile nesihle sempilo yangempela. Imali engenayo, izindleko, izibhili, izinjongo nolwazi — konke endaweni eyodwa, ngaphansi kwenani lebhodlela lamanzi.
hero.note: Ukukhokhelwa kanye kuka-$1 · Zonke izici zivulwa naphakade · I-Paynow, ikhadi, i-EcoCash noma ibhange.

features.heading: Konke okudingayo
features.sub: Izixhobo eziyisithupha ezifundile ezifaka yonke impilo yakho yezimali — akukho ukukhula, akukho indlela yokufunda.

budget.title: Umhleli Webhajethi
budget.text: Setha amabhajethi enyanga ngesigaba ngasinye futhi bukela izindleko zakho ziqhathaniswa nawo ngesikhathi sangempela.

savings.title: Izinjongo Zokonga
savings.text: Chaza izinjongo ezinemihla yokuphela futhi ubone ngokucacile ukuthi ngasinye sesikuphi.

bills.title: Izibhili Nezikhumbuzi
bills.text: Ungaze uphuthelwe usuku lokukhokhela — izibhili ezizayo, ezikhokhelwe nezidlulelwe isikhathi endaweni eyodwa.

reports.title: Imibiko Nokuhlaziya
reports.text: Imali engenayo nezindleko, ukuhlukaniswa kwezigaba nemikhambo eqonda ngempela.

ai.title: Umsizi We-AI
ai.text: Buza imibuzo mayelana nemali yakho ngolimi olula futhi uthola izimpendulo ngokushesha.

safe.title: Kuphephile Ukuchitha
safe.text: Bona inani eliphelele elikuphephile ukulichitha namuhla ngemuva kwezibhili nezinjongo ezifakiwe.

rollover.title: Ukudlulisa Nezikhwama Zokonga
rollover.text: Ibhajethi esele idluliselwa enyangeni elandelayo — futhi izikhwama ezingeceleni ziyakhula ngezindleko ezinkulu ezingavamile.

currency.title: Zonke Izinhlobo Zemali
currency.text: USD, ZWG, ZAR nazo zonke izinhlobo zemali ze-ISO — imali yakho, ifomethi yakho.

reminders.title: Izibhili Aziphuzi
reminders.text: Izixwayiso zokuvuselelwa ngaphambi kokuthi isibhaliso noma isibhili sikukhokhise — akukho ukususwa okumangazayo.

how.heading: Usuqalile futhi usebenza ngomzuzu
how.sub: Izinyathelo ezintathu phakathi kwakho nesithombe esicacile semali yakho.

account.title: Yenza i-akhawunti yakho
account.text: Bhalisa ngegama lakho ne-imeyili — kuthatha imizuzwana engamashumi amathathu.

pay.title: Khokha $1 kube kanye
pay.text: Idola elilodwa. Kanye. I-Paynow, ikhadi, i-EcoCash noma ukudluliselwa kwebhange — okukhethayo.

currency.title: Khetha uhlobo lwemali yakho
currency.text: USD, ZWG, ZAR nazo zonke izinhlobo zemali ze-ISO — setha kanye, zivezwa yonke indawo.

budgets.title: Setha amabhajethi akho
budgets.text: Nikeza isigaba ngasinye inani lenyanga — lona uhlelo lwakho lokuchitha seluqediwe.

accounts.title: Faka ama-akhawunti akho
accounts.text: Ibhange, i-EcoCash, imali — bhala lapho imali yakho ihlala khona ngempela.

log.title: Bhalisa njengoba usuchitha
log.text: Imizuzwana embalwa ngokufaka — noma ngenisa isitatimende se-CSV ngokugcwele.

watch.title: Buka kwanda
watch.text: Amagrafu, izibhili, okuphephile ukulichitha — ideshibhodi igcina uqotho.

own.title: Yiba ngumnini wemali yakho
own.text: Ukufinyelela okugcwele naphakade. Zonke izici, zonke izibuyekezo, azikho izibhaliso.

business.heading: Izixazululo Ze-HR Ezihlanganisiwe
business.line: Imiholo · Ilivi · Izimangalo · Izikweletu · Abantu — konke endaweni eyodwa.
business.sub: Isitolo, ikliniki, isikole, i-NGO noma i-startup — uma ukhokhela abantu, i-WellSpend isebenzela wena. Umuntu ngamunye eqenjini lakho uthola i-app yakhe yemali, futhi abantu abangalawula iholo labo bahlala.
business.payText: Khetha usuku, hlola uhlu, cindezela ukukhokha. Amabhonasi nokulungiswa kungenwa oqondweni olusheshayo lwezele — seqediwe.
business.staffText: Izincwadi zemiholo, izicelo zelivi nezimali ezenzakala kuwo wonke umuntu i-app yakhe. Akukho okunye ukuthumela i-HR ku-WhatsApp ngesiliphu semholo.
business.awayText: Vumela ilivi ngokucindezela okukodwa futhi wonke umuntu ubona ikhalenda elifanayo lalabo abangekho. Akukho ukubhuka kabili, akukho okumangazayo.
business.loansText: Abasebenzi bafaka isicelo, wena uvuma, futhi izinkokhelo ziphuma esiliphini semholo sabo ngokwazo. Akukho ukulandela, akukho izinkomba.
business.accessTitle: Wonke umuntu ubona ingxenye yakhe kuphela
business.accessText: Nikeza i-HR, ama-akhawunti nabaqondisi ukufinyelela kwabo — ulwazi lomholo luhlala luyimfihlo, izimvume zihlala zilungile.
business.fileText: Landa ifayela elilodwa lebhange lakho noma i-EcoCash for Business futhi iqembu lonke selikhokhelwe. Yilona usuku lomholo, seluqediwe.
business.note: Noma ibukhulu, noma yisiphi isimboni — sitshele ngebhizinisi lakho futhi sizobe siqale iqembu lakho ngaphakathi kosuku.

pricing.heading: Idola elilodwa. Yilokho.
pricing.sub: Azikho izibhaliso, azikho amazinga, akukho ukuthengiswa okwengeziwe. Khokha kanye, gcine kuze kube naphakade.
pricing.pay: Khokha nge-Paynow, ikhadi, i-EcoCash noma ukudluliselwa kwebhange

cta.heading: Usulungile ukubona ukuthi imali yakho iya kuphi?
cta.text: Ukubhalisa kuphothulwa nge-$1 eyodwa — bese uhlelo lonke luba nge lakho.
